of the model's performance. Deploying a complex model end-to-end to the online system will result in high latency, which affects user experience. This dilemma also troubles Alibaba engineers. For models with sequence structures, such as DIEN and MIMN, this problem is particularly prominent because the sequence structure in the model implies a serial inference process, and the model cannot be parallelized for acceleration, making model online serving a bottleneck in the entire recommendation process.

So how to solve this problem? The original paper of MIMN released relevant solutions (as shown in Figure 8.15).

Figures 8.15(a) and (b) represent two different online serving architectures, with the horizontal dashed line in the middle representing the separation between online and offline environments.
